name: Shipment to Nethergarde
summary: Biggs' caravan sends a shipment of vital supplies from the Swamp of Sorrows to Nethergarde Keep. The keep needs them to watch over the Dark Portal.

sections.title: A Needed Delivery
sections.body: Biggs asks you to carry supplies saved from ogre attacks to Quartermaster Lungertz at Nethergarde Keep. The keep watches over the Dark Portal from the northern hills of the Blasted Lands. Biggs is repairing his wagon, so the shipment must travel by road without him.

faq.answer: The shipment holds vital supplies rescued from ogre attacks. Quartermaster Lungertz hopes it includes Azoran Crystals, which Nethergarde's stock is running low on.
Biggs packed the supplies for Nethergarde Keep after ogre attacks threatened the caravan.
Quartermaster Lungertz at Nethergarde Keep is waiting for the shipment.
Nethergarde Keep needs the supplies, and Quartermaster Lungertz says its stock of Azoran Crystals is running low.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you carry supplies to Nethergarde Keep, which watches over the Dark Portal.
